summary: Backend regression and live browser testing completed. All six API tests passed; login, barber browsing, booking, payment, history, responsive rendering, and desktop logout were exercised. UI gaps remain for post-booking navigation, appointment management, and mobile logout.

ui_bugs.issue: Logout is hidden at the mobile breakpoint, leaving no visible way to end the authenticated session on mobile.
No Remarcar or Cancelar controls are rendered, although both are required client flows and backend endpoints exist.

integration_issues.issue: Booking creation leaves active navigation on the barber list. The user must discover and click Minha agenda before the payment action becomes available.
BookingModal submits barber.name as barber_id instead of the barber's canonical barber_id (for example, Enzo Martins instead of enzo).

action_items: Add reschedule and cancel actions to appointment cards and connect them to PATCH/DELETE endpoints.
Keep logout accessible on mobile, such as an account menu or visible sidebar action.
Navigate to the agenda after successful booking or expose payment directly in the success state.
Pass barber.barber_id from the booking modal rather than barber.name.
Retest Google OAuth callback/session exchange with a valid provider session when available.
critical_code_review_comments: google_session performs blocking requests.get inside an async FastAPI handler; use an async HTTP client or isolate the blocking call before production traffic.

Frontend API error handling assumes every non-OK response is JSON with detail and can itself throw on non-JSON gateway errors; add robust fallback handling and visible loading/error states for barber and appointment fetches.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created by the test suite; one appointment was created through the real UI/API flow and left in the configured test account history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use cliente.teste.2026@example.com / atelier123. API lifecycle passed. Focus next run on UI reschedule/cancel, mobile logout, post-booking payment discoverability, canonical barber_id, and valid Google callback exchange.
rca of the issue: The appointment component only renders payment state and does not render management actions, despite backend PATCH/DELETE support. BookingModal closes after POST without changing active navigation, so payment is not visible until manual navigation. The mobile CSS explicitly sets .logout to display:none. BookingModal constructs barber_id from barber.name, causing an identifier mismatch with seeded barber records.
